na4821551f48.s: In the LPG framework, globalisation is best described as:
o: The precondition for liberalisation and privatisation
The outcome of liberalisation and privatisation
na4821551f48.x: Globalisation, integration with the world economy, is the outcome of liberalisation and privatisation, not their precondition.

o: Sale of part of a PSU's equity to the public
Government withdrawal from all economic activity
n88f42c39247.x: Disinvestment is the sale of part of a PSU's equity to the public; integration with the world economy is globalisation.

n77b56921fb4.s: About how many tonnes of gold did India pledge with the Bank of England and UBS in 1991?
n77b56921fb4.x: About 67 tonnes of gold were pledged with the Bank of England and UBS during the 1991 balance of payments crisis.

n0d77693a746.s: Which Industrial Policy Statement allowed MRTP firms 25 per cent expansion?
n0d77693a746.x: The 1980 Statement focused on technology upgrading, export orientation and backward areas, and allowed MRTP firms 25 per cent expansion.

ndb69402f251.s: Which of the following pairs about the 1991 Industrial Policy Statement is INCORRECTLY matched?
ndb69402f251.x: The 1991 Statement emphasised de-licensing, restructured MRTP and sought PSU autonomy through MoUs; it did not expand licensing.

nd9bba35f8ea.s: The MRTP Act, 1969 was replaced by the:
nd9bba35f8ea.x: The MRTP Act was replaced by the Competition Act, 2002, administered by the CCI; FEMA replaced FERA.

nc13927a3071.s: Which of the following pairs about the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme is correctly matched?
nc13927a3071.x: The scheme is administered by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency and carbon trading under it is regulated by CERC, not SEBI.

n3144fd07f31.s: Which of the following was cited as an aspect of government failure that justified the 1991 reforms?
o: Complete autonomy of PSUs from political influence
n3144fd07f31.x: Mounting losses, low efficiency, labour problems, project delays and lack of autonomy of PSUs were cited as government failure.

n11b0dfcaf6a.s: The idea of 'embedded autonomy', a bureaucracy insulated from capture yet tied to business, is associated with:
n11b0dfcaf6a.x: Peter Evans gave the idea of embedded autonomy (1995); Chalmers Johnson gave the developmental state.

nc14c97af9f5.s: Besides the IMF and the World Bank, the Washington Consensus package was associated with the:
nc14c97af9f5.x: The Washington Consensus was associated with the IMF, World Bank and US Treasury; the WTO is not part of it.

na28befe8a15.s: After LPG, the shift from Government to Governance meant that the State increasingly acted as:
o: An actor withdrawn completely from the economy
na28befe8a15.x: The post-reform State moved from direct provider to facilitator, regulator and catalyst; it did not withdraw completely.

n10f2a3c52a9.s: After 1991, the RBI's role in the banking sector moved towards that of a:
o: Body that ceased to regulate banks
n10f2a3c52a9.x: Reforms made the RBI a facilitator, freeing bank decisions and enabling private and foreign banks, but it still regulates.

n14bb48b7f23.s: Who popularised the term 'New Public Management' in 1991?
n14bb48b7f23.x: Christopher Hood popularised NPM in 1991; Osborne and Gaebler wrote Reinventing Government (1992).

nf79dd529803.s: The 'New Public Service' approach was propounded by:
nf79dd529803.x: New Public Service, with the slogan 'serve, not steer', is by Denhardt and Denhardt; Mark Moore wrote Creating Public Value.

n6a93fde31f0.s: Which Pay Commission merged Group D into Group C?
n6a93fde31f0.x: The Sixth Commission merged Group D into Group C; the Fifth cut staff strength and the Seventh introduced the pay matrix.

n270d7d23610.s: NITI Aayog's Action Agenda calls for what kind of tenure for lateral entrants?
o: Unstable tenures at the minister's will
n270d7d23610.x: The Action Agenda supports wider lateral entry at middle and senior levels with longer, stable tenures.

n015ccd7b826.s: In the lateral-entry debate, the reservation concern is that:
o: Reservation is automatically enhanced in every post
Reservation applies only to Director posts
Lateral entrants must be from reserved categories
n015ccd7b826.x: Critics point out that lateral recruitment to single posts carries no reservation, along with conflict of interest and demotivation of career officers.

n9e9018c558c.s: In a Results Framework Document, the targets listed for each ministry function as:
n9e9018c558c.x: An RFD specifies objectives, success indicators and targets for each ministry; these serve as Key Result Areas.

nc8fe3ea231d.s: Adverse remarks in Annual Confidential Reports are reviewed by a:
nc8fe3ea231d.x: A Referral Board reviews adverse ACR remarks; 360-degree feedback is multi-source appraisal.

new.s: In the 1991 reforms, devaluation of the rupee was a measure of:
new.x: Devaluation and deficit cuts were short-term stabilisation measures; delicensing was structural adjustment.

new.s: India's foreign exchange reserves in June 1991 had fallen to about:
new.x: Reserves fell to $975 million in June 1991, about two weeks of imports; $7 billion was the IMF assistance sought.

new.s: Industrial delicensing in 1991 is classified as a ____ measure.
new.x: Structural adjustment (medium/long-term) covered delicensing, trade, financial, tax and PSU reforms; stabilisation targeted BoP, inflation and deficit.

new.s: In which year did the Indian rupee become convertible on the current account?
new.x: Current account convertibility came in 1994; capital account convertibility was never fully adopted.

new.s: The MRTP Act was enacted in:
new.x: The MRTP Act was enacted in 1969, relaxed in 1980 and restructured in 1991 before being replaced by the Competition Act, 2002.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the MRTP Act:
1. It was relaxed in 1980.
2. In 1991, its asset limits and pre-entry curbs on expansion, mergers and acquisitions were abolished.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: the MRTP Act was relaxed in 1980, and in 1991 its asset limits and pre-entry curbs were abolished.

new.s: The Rangarajan Committee (1993) dealt with:
new.x: The Rangarajan Committee (1993) dealt with PSU disinvestment; Narasimham dealt with banking and Malhotra with insurance.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Chelliah (1991) dealt with tax reform; Narasimham with banking, Malhotra with insurance and Tarapore with capital account convertibility.

new.s: Reforms of factor markets such as labour, land and power belong to which generation of reforms?
new.x: Factor-market reforms (labour, land, power) are second-generation reforms of the 2000s, not first-generation.

new.s: In July 1991, the rupee was devalued by about:
new.x: The rupee was devalued by about 20 per cent on 1 and 3 July 1991, leading to a market-determined rupee.

new.s: Under first-generation reforms, India's peak tariffs were cut from about 125 per cent to about:
new.x: First-generation reforms (1991-2000) cut tariffs from about 125 per cent to about 30 per cent.

new.s: SEBI is an example of which model of the State?
new.x: SEBI is an independent regulator of the regulatory State; PPP, DBT, GeM and UMANG mark the enabler State.

new.s: Disinvestment in India began in 1991-92 with a target of:
new.x: Disinvestment began in 1991-92 with a target of Rs 2,500 crore, first to bridge the fiscal deficit.

new.s: Which industries are now reserved for the public sector?
new.x: The reserved list fell from 17 to 8 to 3 and now 2: atomic energy and railway operations; defence was opened in 2001.

new.s: SEBI, set up under the SEBI Act in 1992, replaced the:
new.x: SEBI (1992) replaced the Controller of Capital Issues as the securities regulator.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: TRAI was set up in 1997; SEBI dates from 1992, CERC from 1998, IRDA from 1999 and PNGRB from 2006.

new.s: The slogan 'Minimum Government, Maximum Governance' has been used since:
new.x: The slogan dates from 2014: a leaner State governing better through rules, technology and accountability.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Washington Consensus:
1. It was set out by John Williamson in 1989.
2. Market-determined interest rates and a competitive exchange rate are one single prescription.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: market-determined interest rates and a competitive exchange rate are separate prescriptions.

new.s: The 'developmental state' model, based on Japan's MITI (1982), is associated with:
new.x: Chalmers Johnson described the developmental state (1982, Japan MITI); Pritchett coined 'flailing state'.

new.s: Citizens' Charters, service standards and grievance redressal are instruments of which idea?
new.x: Treating the citizen as a customer uses Citizens' Charters, service standards and grievance redressal.

new.s: The main criticism of treating the citizen merely as a customer is that the citizen:
o: Has rights, not just purchasing power
Should be served only by contractors
Has purchasing power but no rights
new.x: Critics say the citizen has rights, not just purchasing power, and that equity and accountability suffer.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Fifth Pay Commission – S. Ratnavel Pandian
Sixth Pay Commission – S. Ratnavel Pandian
new.x: The Fifth, Sixth and Seventh Commissions were chaired by Justices S. Ratnavel Pandian, B.N. Srikrishna and A.K. Mathur.

new.s: Which Pay Commission recommended cutting staff strength by about 30 per cent?
new.x: The Fifth Pay Commission (1997) recommended a staff cut of about 30 per cent and a freeze on new posts.

new.s: The pay matrix replacing pay bands was introduced by the:
new.x: The Seventh Pay Commission replaced the Sixth Commission's running pay bands with a pay matrix.

new.s: 'Prevent rather than cure' describes which principle of Reinventing Government?
new.x: Anticipatory government means prevent rather than cure; enterprising means earn rather than spend.

new.s: 'Creating Public Value' (1995) was written by:
new.x: Mark Moore wrote Creating Public Value (1995), holding that value includes legitimacy and trust.

new.s: Contract labour formed about what share of India's manufacturing workforce in 2022-23?
new.x: Contract labour rose from 20% (1999) to 40.7% (2022-23, ASI) of the manufacturing workforce.

new.s: In August 2024, UPSC was told to cancel the lateral-entry advertisement for how many posts?
new.x: In August 2024, UPSC was told to cancel the lateral-entry advertisement for 45 posts.

new.s: The Results Framework Document was introduced in:
new.x: The RFD was introduced in 2009 under the Cabinet Secretariat's PMES.
